name: Photo shuffle
what: Pictures land on a pile one after another - each flies in from off the frame with a spin and settles tilted, like prints thrown on a table; a handwritten line under the pile.

learned_from.what: photos shuffling in tilted one after another
photos fanning out and settling in a tilted pile

motion: a picture every 18 f: flies 18 f (power3.out) with a spin, overshoots its tilt 4 degrees and settles 8 f; the pile drifts closer
